caption: The drawing depicts a single dress, displayed without a human figure, centered on a plain, light beige background. The dress features a bodice with a slightly off-the-shoulder neckline and short, puffed sleeves that end in scalloped edges trimmed with blue. The bodice is fitted and gathered at the center, accented by a small bow at the neckline and a diagonal seam leading to the waist, which is cinched and tied with a narrow blue ribbon at the back. The skirt is long and full, with gentle pleating at the waist and spreading outward to form a bell shape. The entire dress is decorated with a dense, repeating floral pattern consisting of slender, twig-like stems with small, multicolored flowers and leaves in shades of red, blue, yellow, and green. The delicate, colorful floral design contrasts against the pale, cream-colored background of the dress fabric. There are no additional objects or embellishments in the composition, and the dress appears to float against the blank backdrop.
title: Dress
